req.title: Delete cookie via query string
req.statement: The system shall expire cookies named in the query string of GET /cookies/delete and redirect to /cookies.

doc.reasoning: The delete_cookies handler at GET /cookies/delete reads cookie names from the query string, calls r.delete_cookie(key=key) for each, and returns a 302 redirect to /cookies. Tests must verify: (1) positive path – named cookie is expired via Set-Cookie with past expiration and a 302 redirect to /cookies is issued; (2) negative path – no query params yields a 302 with no Set-Cookie headers; (3) boundary – deleting multiple cookies at once; (4) state transition – cookie previously set is absent after delete+follow; (5) decision table – only the named cookie is deleted, not others. Mutation resilience requires exact status code (302 not 200/301/303), exact Location header value (/cookies), exact Set-Cookie expiry semantics (expires in the past), and exact cookie name matching.

tests.name: test_delete_single_cookie_returns_302_and_expires_cookie
preconditions: Cookie 'session' is set on the client
expected: Set-Cookie header for 'session' contains an expiry in the past (expires=Thu, 01 Jan 1970)
trace: R-HTTPBIN-032: system shall expire cookies named in query string
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_delete_single_cookie_returns_302_and_expires_cookie():
    # First set the cookie
    client.get('/cookies/set/session/abc', follow_redirects=False)
    # Now delete it
    r = client.get('/cookies/delete?session=', follow_redirects=False)
    assert r.status_code == 302
    location = r.headers.get('Location', '')
    assert location == '/cookies' or location.endswith('/cookies')
    set_cookie_headers = r.headers.getlist('Set-Cookie')
    cookie_names = [h.split('=')[0].strip() for h in set_cookie_headers]
    assert 'session' in cookie_names
    session_header = next(h for h in set_cookie_headers if h.startswith('session='))
    assert 'Expires' in session_header or 'expires' in session_header.lower()
    assert '1970' in session_header or 'Thu, 01 Jan 1970' in session_header or 'expires=Thu, 01 Jan 1970' in session_header

test_delete_single_cookie_returns_302_and_expires_cookie()

tests.name: test_delete_multiple_cookies_all_expired_in_single_request
actions: Set cookies a=1, b=2, c=3 via /cookies/set
expected: Set-Cookie headers contain exactly 3 entries, one per cookie name
Each Set-Cookie entry has an expiry in the past
trace: R-HTTPBIN-032: all cookies named in query string are expired
BVA: boundary of multiple (3) cookies deleted simultaneously
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_delete_multiple_cookies_all_expired_in_single_request():
    client.get('/cookies/set?a=1&b=2&c=3', follow_redirects=False)
    r = client.get('/cookies/delete?a=&b=&c=', follow_redirects=False)
    assert r.status_code == 302
    location = r.headers.get('Location', '')
    assert location == '/cookies' or location.endswith('/cookies')
    set_cookie_headers = r.headers.getlist('Set-Cookie')
    assert len(set_cookie_headers) == 3
    deleted_names = {h.split('=')[0].strip() for h in set_cookie_headers}
    assert deleted_names == {'a', 'b', 'c'}
    for h in set_cookie_headers:
        assert 'expires' in h.lower() or 'Expires' in h

test_delete_multiple_cookies_all_expired_in_single_request()

tests.name: test_delete_cookie_state_transition_cookie_absent_after_follow
expected: After delete+follow, GET /cookies returns JSON with 'cookies' dict
The 'cookies' dict does NOT contain key 'token'
trace: R-HTTPBIN-032: cookie is expired and absent from subsequent /cookies response
STC: state transitions from cookie-present to cookie-absent
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
import json
client = app.test_client()

def test_delete_cookie_state_transition_cookie_absent_after_follow():
    client.get('/cookies/set/token/xyz', follow_redirects=True)
    r_check = client.get('/cookies')
    data_before = json.loads(r_check.data)
    assert 'token' in data_before.get('cookies', {})
    client.get('/cookies/delete?token=', follow_redirects=True)
    r_after = client.get('/cookies')
    assert r_after.status_code == 200
    data_after = json.loads(r_after.data)
    assert 'cookies' in data_after
    assert 'token' not in data_after['cookies']

test_delete_cookie_state_transition_cookie_absent_after_follow()

tests.name: test_delete_only_named_cookie_leaves_others_intact
actions: Set cookies keep=yes and remove=yes via /cookies/set
expected: Cookie 'keep' is still present in /cookies response with value 'yes'
trace: R-HTTPBIN-032: only cookies named in query string are expired
DT: decision table row where one cookie is deleted and another is preserved
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
import json
client = app.test_client()

def test_delete_only_named_cookie_leaves_others_intact():
    client.get('/cookies/set?keep=yes&remove=yes', follow_redirects=True)
    r_before = client.get('/cookies')
    data_before = json.loads(r_before.data)
    assert 'keep' in data_before.get('cookies', {})
    assert 'remove' in data_before.get('cookies', {})
    client.get('/cookies/delete?remove=', follow_redirects=True)
    r_after = client.get('/cookies')
    assert r_after.status_code == 200
    data_after = json.loads(r_after.data)
    assert 'remove' not in data_after['cookies']
    assert 'keep' in data_after['cookies']
    assert data_after['cookies']['keep'] == 'yes'

test_delete_only_named_cookie_leaves_others_intact()

tests.name: test_delete_cookie_redirect_location_is_exactly_cookies
actions: Inspect the exact Location header value
expected: Status code is exactly 302 (not 301, not 303, not 200)
Location header ends with exactly '/cookies' (not '/cookies/delete', not '/')
trace: R-HTTPBIN-032: redirect target must be /cookies exactly
BVA: exact redirect code 302 boundary vs 301/303
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_delete_cookie_redirect_location_is_exactly_cookies():
    r = client.get('/cookies/delete?x=', follow_redirects=False)
    assert r.status_code == 302
    assert r.status_code != 301
    assert r.status_code != 303
    assert r.status_code != 200
    location = r.headers.get('Location', '')
    assert location.endswith('/cookies')
    assert not location.endswith('/cookies/delete')
    assert not location.endswith('/cookies/set')
    set_cookie_headers = r.headers.getlist('Set-Cookie')
    assert len(set_cookie_headers) == 1
    assert set_cookie_headers[0].startswith('x=')

test_delete_cookie_redirect_location_is_exactly_cookies()
